data.title: bn-11ba: expose the composed engine's authority, backlog, and fallback state
data.description:
Phase 10 entry point. One coherent observability account of the composed engine, in two surfaces sharing one authority table.

WHAT EXISTS NOW

1. crates/mess-store/src/observability.rs (new). AUTHORITY_MODEL is ADR 0002's classification as data: nine artifact classes, each with a Role (canonical or discardable-accelerator) and a one-line on_loss. EngineObservability { authority, owner, durability, state, accelerators, fallbacks, backlog } is built by LogEngine::observability(), mostly by composing counters that already existed.

2. crates/mess-cli/src/authority.rs (new), wired into mess doctor. Renders the SAME AUTHORITY_MODEL offline, plus a summary and one row per segment: which shape serves it (seal-pack, pidx, log-scan), the fallback the engine would take, and a four-way per-artifact state (present, absent, degraded, shadowed). One summary finding authority-accelerators at ok/info/warn, never error, so the exit code is unchanged. An authority-scope advisory states the offline vs in-process split.

3. docs/observability.md (new). Normative names, units, cardinality bound, and an honest list of what the engine cannot answer.

COMPOSED vs NEW
Composed: EngineMetrics, CommitterMetrics, SealMetricsSnapshot, AppendInputMetrics, SealedCandidateHealth, SealedSegmentIndex per-segment accessors, RegistryState high-water marks, SealedStore install generations, BlockCache, ActiveIndex::applied_end.
New, only where a named AC item had nothing to read: owner conflicts, cancellations, ack latency (in OwnerCompletion::finish); group width and wait (in gather); commit latency (in commit_plans); a live seal backlog gauge plus dequeue counter; registry-delta admitted vs fallback at recovery.

HOT PATH
One Arc clone and one Instant::now per append BATCH, not per event, plus relaxed fetch_adds. mess-log's zero_allocs_per_event_on_the_hot_path stays green.

REVIEW FOCUS
- Is the authority vocabulary right? Nothing may present an accelerator as authoritative.
- The seal-backlog gauge counts rolls inside the Roller path_for callback (the only hook mess-store owns on the roll path). Documented inaccuracy: a roll whose open_next then fails leaves the gauge one high until the next completion. The decrement side saturates.
- Four known gaps are reported rather than faked: no active-index byte accounting, no dedupe state (ADR 0002 s3 undecided), no engine projection checkpoint lag (ADR 0002 s2 undecided), no separate write timer (would need a mess-log change).

TESTS
mess-store engine_observability: 11 tests, 11 passed. mess-cli doctor_authority: 9 tests, 9 passed. Full mess-store 280 passed / 5 skipped; full mess-cli 78 passed / 3 skipped; mess-log alloc 1 passed. just fmt-check clean; cargo check --workspace --all-targets clean; clippy clean on the new files.
